entries.reason: v5's input placeholder names a real company and a real person's e-mail address from the case. ClearCase uses a generic hint with no imported text and no personal data, and a test pins that. Evidence: tests/litigation/conflict.test.ts:82.

entries.reason: v5 matches a substring over space-joined fields, so a query can match across field boundaries and a very short query matches almost everything. ClearCase copies this deliberately (adding case, width and diacritic folding). Per-field matching or a minimum length would need an app change. Evidence: src/lib/views/litigation/conflict.ts:30.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5's free-text box has no Enter-key handler; only Check or the select runs the search. ClearCase copies this: the box is a plain input outside a form, with no key handler. Handling Enter would be an app change. Evidence: src/routes/v/[vid]/litigation/conflict_tab/+page.svelte:13.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 concatenates e-mail and organisation unguarded, so an empty e-mail shows as empty brackets and a missing field prints and is searched as undefined. ClearCase copies this on purpose (tested); a guard would be an app change. Evidence: src/lib/views/litigation/conflict.ts:13.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 keys saved step statuses by array index, so changing the order or count remaps them to other steps. ClearCase keys each status by a digest of the step's phase and step text and discloses duplicate steps instead of guessing. Evidence: tests/litigation/enforcement.test.ts:20.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 leaves no option selected when a seed status is outside the list, so the browser shows To do while the stored value differs. ClearCase adds the imported status, and a saved one no longer offered, as its own option so the select shows what is stored. Evidence: tests/litigation/enforcement.test.ts:46.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 splits evidence refs only on spaces and commas, so semicolons or newlines leave refs unresolved. ClearCase copies this deliberately and the test pins it. Splitting on more separators would be an app change. Evidence: src/lib/views/litigation/heads.ts:7.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 has no reorder or edit of submissions and deletes by position without a prompt. ClearCase deletes by stable row id only once confirmed: Delete shows Confirm delete and Cancel inline, and the server deletes nothing unless the request names the confirmed row. The same question also appears on Cross-examination and on all seven generic registers. It still has no reorder and no edit. Those would need an app change. Evidence: src/routes/v/[vid]/litigation/heads_tab/+page.server.ts:40.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 copies the seed topics into user storage on first render, so later seeds are never shown. ClearCase reads seeds from the package on every render and stores only the user's edits and deletions as overlays, so a newer seed shows, with a disclosure when an edit conflicts. Evidence: tests/litigation/crossexam.test.ts:12.
